title: Performance Overview
final_value_desc: Total account value at end of backtest, including cash and positions
return_desc: Total return on investment: (Final Value - Initial Capital) / Initial Capital
sharpe_ratio_desc: Risk-adjusted return metric, measures excess return per unit risk. > 1 is good, > 2 is excellent
max_drawdown_desc: Largest peak-to-trough decline, measures worst-case loss risk
sqn_desc: System Quality Number, measures trading system robustness. > 2 good, > 3 excellent, > 5 superb
win_rate_desc: Percentage of profitable trades among all closed trades
closed_trades_desc: Total number of completed trades during the backtest
dd_duration_desc: Number of bars the max drawdown lasted, measures recovery time
calmar_desc: Annual return divided by max drawdown, measures long-term risk-adjusted performance. > 1 is good
vwr_desc: Volatility-Weighted Return, rewards lower volatility with higher scores
